claim_boundary: one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, one Triton GPU runtime, controlled traffic; no production SLA, HA/DR, multi-node, multi-GPU, MIG, MPS, physical zero-downtime, or CUDA kernel-overlap claim

rca.observed: All 32 bounded readiness requests returned HTTP 200 but were accepted by one of four expected uvicorn workers, so the exact worker-set gate correctly timed out before r1/w4 warmup.
rca.scope: The prior r1/w2 rollout remediation passed all three repetitions. This failure is the sequential readiness attribution round for r1/w4, not a workload result or a server topology acceptance result.
rca.unproven: The exact operating-system or uvicorn accept-scheduling mechanism is not independently proven.
rca.why_fail_closed: A sequential one-shot probe loop does not deterministically exercise every idle server worker even when all workers are healthy; accepting one observed worker would weaken the frozen physical-attribution contract.
